metadata.question: Did burn scars near San Jose, California on August 26, 2020 expand in comparison to the same region in June?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: I need to compare burn scars (or fire-affected areas) near San Jose, California between June 2020 and August 26, 2020. I'll use Landsat 8 data and calculate the Normalized Burn Ratio (NBR) or look at reflectance changes. Higher NBR values indicate less burn severity, so lower NBR = more burned areas. 2. Masking strategy: I should mask clouds to get clear views of the ground. I may also need to exclude water and vegetation. The question is about burned area expansion, so I need to detect where burn scars exist. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - If no images are found in June or August → C1 - If valid pixels after masking are 0 → C2 - If calculation fails (NaN, None, invalid values) → C3 - If burned area in August > June → A (expansion) - If burned area in August ≤ June → B (no expansion) I'll use NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio) = (NIR - SWIR) / (NIR + SWIR). Lower NBR indicates burned areas. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define San Jose region const sanJose = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.8863, 37.3382]); const region = sanJose.buffer(25000); // 25km buffer // Cloud masking function for Landsat 8 const maskClouds = (img) => { const qa = img.select('pixel_qa'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0)); return img.updateMask(mask); }; // Calculate NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio) const calcNBR = (img) => { const nir = img.select('B5'); const swir = img.select('B7'); const nbr = nir.subtract(swir).divide(nir.add(swir)).rename('NBR'); return img.addBands(nbr); }; // June 2020 collection const june2020 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C01/T1') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2020-06-01', '2020-06-30') .map(maskClouds) .map(calcNBR); const juneSize = june2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`June 2020 Images: ${juneSize}`); if (juneSize === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // August 26, 2020 collection const august2020 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C01/T1') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2020-08-20', '2020-08-31') .map(maskClouds) .map(calcNBR); const augSize = august2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`August 2020 Images: ${augSize}`); if (augSize === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // Composite and get median NBR const juneComp = june2020.median(); const augComp = august2020.median(); // Count valid pixels (NBR exists) const juneCount = juneComp.select('NBR').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const augCount = augComp.select('NBR').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const juneValidPixels = juneCount.NBR || 0; const augValidPixels = augCount.NBR || 0; console.log(`June Valid Pixels: ${juneValidPixels}, August Valid Pixels: ${augValidPixels}`); if (juneValidPixels === 0 || augValidPixels === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // Define burned area as NBR < -0.1 (threshold for burned vegetation) const juneBurned = juneComp.select('NBR').lt(-0.1); const augBurned = augComp.select('NBR').lt(-0.1); // Count burned pixels const juneBurnedCount = juneBurned.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const augBurnedCount = augBurned.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const juneBurnedPixels = juneBurnedCount.NBR || 0; const augBurnedPixels = augBurnedCount.NBR || 0; console.log(`June Burned Pixels: ${juneBurnedPixels}`); console.log(`August Burned Pixels: ${augBurnedPixels}`); // Validate results if (juneBurnedPixels === null || augBurnedPixels === null) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare burn scars if (augBurnedPixels > juneBurnedPixels) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { return new Promise(async (resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, () => { ee.initialize(null, null, async () => { try { await runAnalysis(); resolve(); } catch (e) { console.log('D'); reject(e); } }, (err) => { console.log('D'); reject(err); }); }, (err) => { console.log('D'); reject(err); }); }); } initEE().catch(() => {}); ```
